{"parentUuid":"2a18193b-8b84-4f8a-aec4-42aeee28eeac","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"db0ce81c-ab44-455b-bdba-0a962628c968","agentId":"af4fd46b5647ca30c","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01CjYdzQUtp5Ujo9SsHB2kXg","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Device-signed, replay-resistant request envelope (Phase 9 W1-A) — the bridge auth keystone.\n2\t\n3\tThe phone (a device the owner AUTHORIZED via `sigil.mesh.authorize_device`) signs EACH request to the\n4\tdesktop bridge with ITS OWN Ed25519 key over the canonical envelope core. There is NO wire bearer\n5\tsecret: authentication IS the signature, verified against the owner-minted authorized-device set. This\n6\tmirrors the approval-record pattern (`agents.approvals._approval_message` / `verify_approval`) — same\n7\tcanonical-JSON message, same fail-closed `verify_one`, same trust pinned to owner-minted device keys\n8\t(a rogue/revoked device cannot self-authorize; a tampered field breaks the signature).\n9\t\n10\tReplay resistance is a deterministic, spine-anchored monotonic-nonce highwater PER DEVICE: an effectful\n11\trequest must carry a nonce strictly greater than the highest nonce that device has ever been receipted\n12\tfor. Reads still receipt (advancing the watermark) but skip the freshness gate (they have no side\n13\teffect). The receipt is an append-only spine event, so the watermark is tamper-evident memory.\n14\t\n15\tThis module is PURE by construction — NO wallclock, NO RNG. The caller supplies `nonce` and `ts` so the\n16\tJS phone client and Python reproduce the exact signed bytes (the parity contract) and so freshness is a\n17\tdeterministic function of the spine. A wallclock timestamp-WINDOW check (is `ts` recent?) belongs to\n18\tthe server transport layer, not here. Offense-free.\"\"\"\n19\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n20\t\n21\tfrom typing import Set, Tuple, Union\n22\t\n23\tfrom ..reuse import canonical_json, sign, verify_one\n24\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n25\t\n26\t# The request vocabulary the bridge accepts — a fail-closed allow-list. `panic`/`relay` are effectful;\n27\t# the `read:*` family is side-effect-free. An action outside this set is refused even if validly signed.\n28\tACTIONS = frozenset({\"panic\", \"relay\", \"read:snapshot\", \"read:pending\", \"read:record\",\n29\t                     \"read:stream\", \"read:recall\"})\n30\t\n31\t# The spine signal marking a consumed request. Its records form the per-device nonce highwater.\n32\tRECEIPT_SIGNAL = \"mesh.request\"\n33\t\n34\t\n35\tdef envelope_message(core: dict) -> bytes:\n36\t    \"\"\"The exact bytes signed/verified — canonical JSON of the core. This is the JS<->Python parity\n37\t    contract: a future JS client MUST produce these identical bytes. Mirrors\n38\t    `agents.approvals._approval_message` (return bytes; encode only if `canonical_json` gave a str).\"\"\"\n39\t    m = canonical_json(core)\n40\t    return m if isinstance(m, bytes) else m.encode()\n41\t\n42\t\n43\tdef build_core(device_pubkey: str, action: str, args: dict, nonce, ts) -> dict:\n44\t    \"\"\"The signed core. `nonce`/`ts` are caller-supplied (this module never reads a clock or RNG).\"\"\"\n45\t    return {\"v\": 1, \"device\": device_pubkey, \"action\": action, \"args\": args, \"nonce\": nonce, \"ts\": ts}\n46\t\n47\t\n48\tdef sign_envelope(device_key, core: dict) -> dict:\n49\t    \"\"\"Phone/test side: attach a DEVICE signature over the canonical core, producing the wire payload.\"\"\"\n50\t    return {**core, \"sig\": sign(device_key.private_key_b64, envelope_message(core))}\n51\t\n52\t\n53\tdef verify_envelope(payload, authorized: Set[str]) -> Tuple[bool, Union[dict, str]]:\n54\t    \"\"\"Fail-closed authentication. Rebuild the core (payload minus `sig`); refuse if there is no sig /\n55\t    no device / the device is not in the owner-minted authorized set; then Ed25519-verify the signature\n56\t    over the canonical core; finally require the (now-authenticated) action to be in the `ACTIONS`\n57\t    allow-list. Mirrors `agents.approvals.verify_approval`. Returns (True, core) or (False, reason).\"\"\"\n58\t    p = payload.payload if hasattr(payload, \"payload\") else payload\n59\t    sig = p.get(\"sig\")\n60\t    device = p.get(\"device\")\n61\t    if not sig or not device:\n62\t        return False, \"missing signature or device\"\n63\t    if device not in authorized:                       # trust pinned to owner-minted device keys\n64\t        return False, \"device is not authorized\"\n65\t    core = {k: v for k, v in p.items() if k != \"sig\"}\n66\t    if not verify_one(device, envelope_message(core), sig):\n67\t        return False, \"signature invalid\"\n68\t    if core.get(\"action\") not in ACTIONS:              # allow-list the authenticated action (fail-closed)\n69\t        return False, f\"unknown action: {core.get('action')!r}\"\n70\t    return True, core\n71\t\n72\t\n73\tdef record_receipt(store: SpineStore, core: dict) -> int:\n74\t    \"\"\"Append the append-only consumption receipt. It forks the WS-C glass-cockpit server\n3\t(`sigil.ui.server`) verbatim in shape (ThreadingHTTPServer + BaseHTTPRequestHandler, the strict\n4\tCSP/nosniff/no-referrer header set, the body cap + 30s timeout, the never-log-auth `log_message`,\n5\tthe SSE structure, the anti-DNS-rebinding Host/Origin/Referer gate) and changes ONLY three things:\n6\t\n7\t  • THE BIND. It binds a `bind_ok` address (loopback or a PRIVATE/WireGuard address) — NEVER\n8\t    0.0.0.0 / a public address. The constructor asserts this; the CLI asserts it too. This is the\n9\t    non-negotiable exposure guard: the tunnel, not the transport, is the network boundary.\n10\t\n11\t  • THE AUTH. There is NO wire bearer secret (the ui's printed token is gone). Authentication IS a\n12\t    per-request Ed25519 signature the phone makes with ITS OWN owner-authorized device key — the\n13\t    Wave-1 device envelope (`bridge.envelope`). The server verifies the signature against the\n14\t    owner-minted authorized-device set (recomputed PER REQUEST so a revocation takes effect at once),\n15\t    binds the authenticated envelope `action` to the endpoint it hit (a `read:pending` envelope can\n16\t    never reach the more-sensitive `read:recall`), applies a wallclock timestamp-freshness window\n17\t    (injectable clock), and for EFFECTFUL actions (panic/relay) additionally runs the envelope's\n18\t    strict monotonic-nonce replay gate (`consume(effectful=True)`). The owner trust-root is NEVER used\n19\t    to sign anything here — the phone signs, the server only verifies.\n20\t\n21\t  • THE ALLOWLIST. The anti-rebind Host/Origin allowlist is derived from the REAL bound address (plus\n22\t    the loopback pair when bound to loopback, for dev), not a hardcoded 127.0.0.1.\n23\t\n24\tEverything sensitive stays off the minimal frames: `/api/pending` and the SSE stream carry only\n25\t`{seq, tier, kind}` — never a subject, never a payload, never a secret. TLS wrapping is a LATER\n26\tslice; this is plain HTTP inside the tunnel. Offense-free.\"\"\"\n27\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n28\t\n29\timport base64\n30\timport ipaddress\n31\timport json\n32\timport time\n33\tfrom http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer\n34\tfrom pathlib import Path\n35\tfrom urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse\n36\t\n37\tfrom ..config import SPINE_PATH\n38\tfrom ..governor.identity import owner_pubkey\n39\tfrom ..mesh import authorized_devices\n40\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n41\tfrom ..spine.verify import verify_record\n42\tfrom .daemon import BridgeDaemon, bind_ok\n43\tfrom .envelope import consume, verify_envelope\n44\tfrom .notifier import PushNotifier\n45\t\n46\t_WEBAPP = Path(__file__).parent / \"webapp\"       # the PWA is a later slice — served if present, else 404\n47\t_CSP = \"default-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'\"\n48\t_DEFAULT_PORT = 8722\n49\t_TS_WINDOW = 120.0                               # ± seconds a request timestamp may differ from the server clock\n50\t\n51\t# Each network endpoint declares the ONE envelope action that authorizes it. Binding the\n52\t# authenticated action to the endpoint stops a captured lesser-scoped envelope (e.g. `read:pending`,\n53\t# which leaks only {seq,tier,kind}) from being replayed against a more-sensitive endpoint (e.g.\n54\t# `read:recall`, which surfaces the owner's on-screen OCR history). `/api/graph` piggybacks on the\n55\t# `read:snapshot` scope: graph returns only aggregate health, strictly LESS sensitive than the\n56\t# snapshot, so a snapshot-scoped envelope reaching it is not an escalation (and a lesser envelope\n57\t# still cannot reach it).\n58\t_READ_ACTION = {\n59\t    \"/api/pending\": \"read:pending\",\n60\t    \"/api/snapshot\": \"read:snapshot\",\n61\t    \"/api/graph\": \"read:snapshot\",\n62\t    \"/api/stream\": \"read:stream\",\n63\t    \"/api/recall\": \"read:recall\",\n64\t}\n65\t\n66\t\n67\tclass BridgeServer(ThreadingHTTPServer):\n68\t    daemon_threads = True\n69\t\n70\t    def __init__(self, addr, handler, *, spine_path, trusted_pubkey=None, clock=None,\n71\t                 ts_window: float = _TS_WINDOW):\n72\t        host = addr[0]\n73\t        if not bind_ok(host):\n74\t            raise ValueError(\n75\t                f\"refusing to bind {host!r}: the bridge binds loopback or a PRIVATE (WireGuard) \"\n76\t                f\"address only — never 0.0.0.0 / an unspecified / a public address\")\n77\t        super().__init__(addr, handler)\n78\t        self.spine_path = Path(spine_path)\n79\t        # the owner PUBLIC key is the trust anchor (injectable for tests); NO private key ever lives here\n80\t        self.trusted_pubkey = trusted_pubkey if trusted_pubkey is not None else owner_pubkey()\n81\t        self.clock = clock or time.time          # injectable wallclock so the freshness gate is deterministic\n82\t        self.ts_window = ts_window\n83\t        port = self.server_address[1]            # the ACTUAL bound port (correct even for port 0)\n84\t        hosts = {f\"{host}:{port}\"}\n85\t        origins = {f\"http://{host}:{port}\"}\n86\t        if ipaddress.ip_address(host).is_loopback:   # dev convenience only — not added for a WG bind\n87\t            hosts |= {f\"127.0.0.1:{port}\", f\"localhost:{port}\"}\n88\t            origins |= {f\"http://127.0.0.1:{port}\", f\"http://localhost:{port}\"}\n89\t        self.allowed_hosts = frozenset(hosts)\n90\t        self.allowed_origins = frozenset(origins)\n91\t\n92\t    def store(self) -> SpineStore:\n93\t        return SpineStore(self.spine_path)       # fresh read each request (cheap, current)\n94\t\n95\t    def daemon(self) -> BridgeDaemon:\n96\t        return BridgeDaemon(self.store(), trusted_pubkey=self.trusted_pubkey)\n97\t\n98\t\n99\tdef _json_bytes(obj) -> bytes:\n100\t    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False).encode(\"utf-8\")\n101\t\n102\t\n103\tclass Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):\n104\t    server_version = \"sigil-bridge/1.0\"\n105\t    timeout = 30                                  # per-connection socket timeout (no hung reader)\n106\t    _MAX_BODY = 65536                             # bodies are tiny; cap to avoid a Content-Length hang/alloc\n107\t\n108\t    # never log auth (an envelope can ride in ?env= for SSE; never write it to a log)\n109\t    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):  # noqa: A003\n110\t        pass\n111\t\n112\t    # --- request helpers --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n113\t    def _query(self) -> dict:\n114\t        return parse_qs(urlparse(self.path).query)\n115\t\n116\t    def _authorized_now(self):\n117\t        \"\"\"The owner-minted authorized-device set, recomputed PER REQUEST — a revoke takes effect now.\"\"\"\n118\t        return authorized_devices(self.server.store(), self.server.trusted_pubkey)\n119\t\n120\t    def _envelope_payload(self):\n121\t        \"\"\"The device envelope: base64url of canonical JSON, in `X-SIGIL-Envelope` (GET/POST) or the\n122\t        `?env=` query (SSE, which cannot set a header). An agent\n2\tQUEUES a proposal (governor → QUEUE); the owner APPROVES or DENIES it here. Authentication is an\n3\tEd25519 signature over the canonical (target, decision, approver) by the OWNER key.\n4\t\n5\tRED-PEN HARDENING (Phase 6):\n6\t • The trusted pubkey is the PERSISTED owner identity — NOT the key supplied to the queue, so an\n7\t   attacker cannot self-certify by bringing their own key (RP-APPROVAL-2). approve/deny require the\n8\t   supplied signing key to BE the trusted owner key.\n9\t • `pending()` treats a queued item as resolved ONLY when a superseding approval VERIFIES against the\n10\t   trusted owner key, and keys resolution off the SIGNED target_seq (not the raw supersedes_id) — so\n11\t   an unsigned/forged approval can't silently drop an item (RP-1/RP-APPROVAL-1), and a genuine\n12\t   approval of one item can't be replayed onto another (RP-APPROVAL-4). `verify_approval` is thereby\n13\t   on the enforcement path (RP-APPROVAL-3).\n14\t\n15\tThis records the DECISION; it executes no external effect (SIGIL has no send/deploy path). The\n16\ttransport (Telegram/WhatsApp over WireGuard, §9.3) is a seam over this authenticated core.\"\"\"\n17\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n18\t\n19\tfrom typing import List, Optional\n20\t\n21\tfrom ..reuse import canonical_json, sha256_hex, sign, verify_one\n22\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n23\t\n24\tSIGNAL = \"governor.approval\"\n25\t_QUEUED_STATUS = \"awaiting-approval\"\n26\t\n27\t\n28\tdef _approval_message(target_seq, decision: str, approver: str) -> bytes:\n29\t    m = canonical_json({\"target\": target_seq, \"decision\": decision, \"approver\": approver})\n30\t    return m if isinstance(m, bytes) else m.encode()\n31\t\n32\t\n33\tdef verify_approval(record, trusted_pubkey_b64: Optional[str], *, extra_pubkeys=None) -> bool:\n34\t    \"\"\"True iff the approval carries a valid signature over its (target, decision, approver) by the\n35\t    OWNER key OR by a currently-authorized DEVICE key (`extra_pubkeys`). The claimed `pubkey` must be\n36\t    in the allowed set — which is composed ONLY of owner-minted keys (the owner identity + the\n37\t    owner-signed device-authorization ledger, see `sigil.mesh`) — so a key the requester merely\n38\t    presents is never trusted (RP-APPROVAL-2). The signed `target_seq` still binds (RP-APPROVAL-4).\n39\t    Unsigned / not-in-allowed-set / no-trusted-key → False (fail-closed).\"\"\"\n40\t    p = record.payload if hasattr(record, \"payload\") else record\n41\t    sig, pub = p.get(\"sig\"), p.get(\"pubkey\")\n42\t    allowed = set()\n43\t    if trusted_pubkey_b64:\n44\t        allowed.add(trusted_pubkey_b64)\n45\t    if extra_pubkeys:\n46\t        allowed.update(extra_pubkeys)\n47\t    if not sig or not pub or pub not in allowed:\n48\t        return False\n49\t    msg = _approval_message(p.get(\"target_seq\"), p.get(\"approval\"), p.get(\"approver\"))\n50\t    return verify_one(pub, msg, sig)                # verify against the (owner-minted) claimed key\n51\t\n52\t\n53\tdef pending(store: SpineStore, trusted_pubkey_b64: Optional[str] = None, *, extra_pubkeys=None) -> List:\n54\t    \"\"\"Queued proposals with NO valid approval yet, oldest first. Resolution requires a VERIFIED\n55\t    owner/authorized-device approval; an unsigned/forged/unauthorized approval leaves the item\n56\t    pending (fail-closed).\"\"\"\n57\t    if trusted_pubkey_b64 is None:\n58\t        from ..governor.identity import owner_pubkey\n59\t        trusted_pubkey_b64 = owner_pubkey()\n60\t    resolved = set()\n61\t    queued = {}\n62\t    for r in store.iter_records():\n63\t        p = r.payload\n64\t        if p.get(\"signal\") == SIGNAL and verify_approval(r, trusted_pubkey_b64, extra_pubkeys=extra_pubkeys):\n65\t            resolved.add(p.get(\"target_seq\"))       # honor the SIGNED target, not raw supersedes_id\n66\t        if p.get(\"decision\") == \"queued\" and p.get(\"status\") == _QUEUED_STATUS:\n67\t            queued[r.seq] = r\n68\t    return [r for seq, r in sorted(queued.items()) if seq not in resolved]\n69\t\n70\t\n71\tclass ApprovalError(Exception):\n72\t    pass\n73\t\n74\t\n75\tclass ApprovalQueue:\n76\t    def __init__(self, store: Optional[SpineStore] = None, *, owner_key=None,\n77\t                 trusted_pubkey_b64: Optional[str] = None):\n78\t        from ..governor.identity import owner_keypair, owner_pubkey\n79\t        self.store = store or SpineStore()\n80\t        self.owner_key = owner_key if owner_key is not None else owner_keypair()\n81\t        # PINNED to the persisted owner identity — never defaulted to the supplied key (RP-APPROVAL-2)\n82\t        self.trusted_pubkey_b64 = trusted_pubkey_b64 if trusted_pubkey_b64 is not None else owner_pubkey()\n83\t\n84\t    def _target(self, seq: int):\n85\t        for r in pending(self.store, self.trusted_pubkey_b64):\n86\t            if r.seq == seq:\n87\t                return r\n88\t        raise ApprovalError(f\"seq {seq} is not a pending approval (already decided, or not queued)\")\n89\t\n90\t    def _decide(self, seq: int, decision: str, *, approver: str, reason: str = \"\") -> int:\n91\t        target = self._target(seq)\n92\t        # the signing key MUST be the trusted owner key — not merely \"some key present\" (RP-APPROVAL-2).\n93\t        if (self.owner_key is None or self.trusted_pubkey_b64 is None\n94\t                or self.owner_key.public_key_b64 != self.trusted_pubkey_b64):\n95\t            raise ApprovalError(\"approval requires the OWNER's signing key (missing or not the trusted key)\")\n96\t        msg = _approval_message(seq, decision, approver)\n97\t        sig = sign(self.owner_key.private_key_b64, msg)\n98\t        payload = {\"signal\": SIGNAL, \"approval\": decision, \"target_seq\": seq, \"target_kind\": target.kind,\n99\t                   \"target_tier\": target.payload.get(\"tier\"), \"approver\": approver, \"reason\": reason,\n100\t                   \"pubkey\": self.trusted_pubkey_b64, \"sig\": sig, \"msg_digest\": sha256_hex(msg),\n101\t                   \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"}\n102\t        return self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"governor\", actor=\"OWNER\",\n103\t                                 payload=payload, supersedes_id=seq)\n104\t\n105\t    def approve(self, seq: int, *, approver: str = \"owner\", reason: str = \"\") -> int:\n106\t        return self._decide(seq, \"approved\", approver=approver, reason=reason)\n107\t\n108\t    def deny(self, seq: int, *, approver: str = \"owner\", reason: str = \"\") -> int:\n109\t        return self._decide(seq, \"denied\", approver=approver, reason=reason)\n110\t"}]},"uuid":"3ca0b099-b996-43d5-bd13-0b47972c5707","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:56:56.851Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"4dabc3db-da31-497a-994f-4cca0abb923f","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"09065d09-ffc1-4183-82a6-f41e7d7b4fe5","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"db0ce81c-ab44-455b-bdba-0a962628c968","agentId":"af4fd46b5647ca30c","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01AYSf6hpyw7oethjXYm9o5Z","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"BridgeDaemon (Phase 7, WS-D D-v) — the desktop-side API the phone talks to over WireGuard. It\n2\treuses the owner-signed cores: the queue (`approvals.pending` with the authorized-device set), a\n3\tDEVICE-signed approval (accepted only while that device is authorized), a PANIC halt (any engage is\n4\tfail-safe), and a KERNEL command relay (`KernelDispatch` → the same WARDEN gate as voice/UI).\n5\t\n6\tThis module is the bridge LIBRARY CORE + API (the doctrine + crypto). The network TRANSPORT — an\n7\tHTTP server over WireGuard, reusing the WS-C two-plane server pattern bound to a `bind_ok` address —\n8\tis a documented NEXT slice, not shipped here. `bind_ok` is the bind predicate that transport MUST\n9\tuse: loopback or a PRIVATE (WireGuard) address only — NEVER 0.0.0.0 / a public address.\"\"\"\n10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n11\t\n12\timport ipaddress\n13\tfrom typing import List, Optional\n14\t\n15\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n16\t\n17\t\n18\tdef bind_ok(addr: str) -> bool:\n19\t    \"\"\"True iff `addr` is safe to bind: loopback or a PRIVATE (e.g. WireGuard) address — never\n20\t    0.0.0.0 / a public / an unspecified address.\"\"\"\n21\t    try:\n22\t        ip = ipaddress.ip_address(addr)\n23\t    except ValueError:\n24\t        return False\n25\t    if ip.is_unspecified:                          # 0.0.0.0 / :: → refuse\n26\t        return False\n27\t    return ip.is_loopback or ip.is_private\n28\t\n29\t\n30\tclass BridgeDaemon:\n31\t    def __init__(self, store: Optional[SpineStore] = None, *, trusted_pubkey: Optional[str] = None):\n32\t        from ..governor.identity import owner_pubkey\n33\t        self.store = store or SpineStore()\n34\t        # the owner trust anchor — the persisted identity by default (injectable for tests)\n35\t        self.trusted_pubkey = trusted_pubkey if trusted_pubkey is not None else owner_pubkey()\n36\t\n37\t    def _authorized(self):\n38\t        from ..mesh import authorized_devices\n39\t        return authorized_devices(self.store, self.trusted_pubkey)\n40\t\n41\t    def pending(self) -> List[dict]:\n42\t        \"\"\"The phone-facing queue — minimal fields only (no subject leaks over the tunnel).\"\"\"\n43\t        from ..agents.approvals import pending\n44\t        items = pending(self.store, self.trusted_pubkey, extra_pubkeys=self._authorized())\n45\t        return [{\"seq\": r.seq, \"tier\": r.payload.get(\"tier\"), \"kind\": r.kind} for r in items]\n46\t\n47\t    def recall(self, subject: str) -> Optional[dict]:\n48\t        \"\"\"Read-only remote RECALL — \"where did I last see X?\" — answered from the owner's own\n49\t        GROUNDED on-screen OCR history. Returns the perception-recall provenance dict VERBATIM\n50\t        (seq/entry_hash/when/frame_sha256/quote) or None: A0, read-only, no VLM and no paraphrase —\n51\t        the served `quote` is the owner's verbatim captured OCR line, never an advisory VLM lead.\n52\t\n53\t        This surfaces the owner's own on-screen text over the tunnel, so it leaks MORE than\n54\t        `pending()`'s minimal {seq,tier,kind} fields. The network SERVER (a later slice) MUST\n55\t        therefore gate this behind an authorized-device (device-signed) read request; this daemon\n56\t        method is only the read-only core.\"\"\"\n57\t        from ..perception.recall import recall\n58\t        return recall(self.store, subject)\n59\t\n60\t    def submit_device_approval(self, payload: dict) -> int:\n61\t        \"\"\"Append a DEVICE-signed approval the phone produced — ONLY if the signing device is\n62\t        currently authorized AND the signature verifies (fail-closed). A rogue/revoked device or a\n63\t        forged signature is refused; the signed target_seq binds (no replay).\"\"\"\n64\t        from ..agents.approvals import SIGNAL as APPROVAL_SIGNAL\n65\t        from ..agents.approvals import verify_approval\n66\t\n67\t        class _Rec:\n68\t            def __init__(self, p): self.payload = p\n69\t        authorized = self._authorized()\n70\t        if payload.get(\"signal\") != APPROVAL_SIGNAL:\n71\t            raise ValueError(\"not an approval record\")\n72\t        if payload.get(\"pubkey\") not in authorized:\n73\t            raise ValueError(\"signing device is not authorized\")\n74\t        if not verify_approval(_Rec(payload), self.trusted_pubkey, extra_pubkeys=authorized):\n75\t            raise ValueError(\"approval signature invalid\")\n76\t        return self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"mesh\", actor=\"DEVICE\",\n77\t                                 payload={**payload, \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"},\n78\t                                 supersedes_id=payload.get(\"target_seq\"))\n79\t\n80\t    def panic_engage(self, *, by: str = \"phone\") -> int:\n81\t        \"\"\"Halt the mesh from the phone. ANY engage halts (fail-safe) — no signature needed for the\n82\t        SAFE direction. Release stays owner-only at the desktop (the dangerous direction is signed).\"\"\"\n83\t        from ..governor.killswitch import SIGNAL as KS_SIGNAL\n84\t        return self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"mesh\", actor=\"DEVICE\",\n85\t                                 payload={\"signal\": KS_SIGNAL, \"state\": \"engaged\", \"by\": by,\n86\t                                          \"reason\": \"panic halt from phone\", \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"})\n87\t\n88\t    def relay(self, text: str) -> str:\n89\t        \"\"\"Relay a KERNEL command — the same T0-router + WARDEN gate + signed action log as voice/UI.\"\"\"\n90\t        from ..voice.dispatch import KernelDispatch\n91\t        return KernelDispatch().send(text)\n92\t"}]},"uuid":"ccac3f70-ede7-403c-af47-1f879dcabf0a","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:57:51.599Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"09065d09-ffc1-4183-82a6-f41e7d7b4fe5","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"9ca21801-d80d-41a5-ae67-cffcd397c1ec","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"db0ce81c-ab44-455b-bdba-0a962628c968","agentId":"af4fd46b5647ca30c","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_018WHJC9njumBNuLFe3QuhhW","type":"tool_result","content":"test_actor.py\ntest_agents_phase4.py\ntest_agents.py\ntest_bridge_envelope.py\ntest_bridge_recall.py\ntest_bridge_server.py\ntest_cli_mesh.py\ntest_consolidate.py\ntest_gesture.py\ntest_gesture_remote.py\n---next.py---\n\"\"\"PushNotifier (Phase 7, WS-D D-vi) — pushes to the phone when an A2/A3 item QUEUES, fed by the\nSHARED P0 `SpineTailer` (the same primitive the UI SSE feed uses). The push carries ONLY\n`{seq, tier, kind}` — never the subject, never the payload, never a secret — so nothing sensitive\ncrosses even the WireGuard tunnel; the phone fetches any detail on demand over the daemon API. No\ncloud push (that would egress the private subject off owned hardware).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import List, Optional\n\nfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\nfrom ..spine.tail import SpineTailer\n\n\nclass PushNotifier:\n    def __init__(self, store: Optional[SpineStore] = None, *, since_seq: Optional[int] = None):\n        self.store = store or SpineStore()\n        start = since_seq if since_seq is not None else self.store.next_seq - 1\n        self.tailer = SpineTailer(self.store, since_seq=start)\n\n    def poll(self) -> List[dict]:\n        \"\"\"New pushes since the last poll: one per newly-QUEUED A2/A3 item, minimal fields only.\"\"\"\n        out: List[dict] = []\n        for ev in self.tailer.poll():\n            rec = self.store.get(ev[\"seq\"])\n            p = rec.payload if rec else {}\n            if (p.get(\"decision\") == \"queued\" and p.get(\"status\") == \"awaiting-approval\"\n                    and p.get(\"tier\") in (\"A2\", \"A3\")):\n                out.append({\"seq\": ev[\"seq\"], \"tier\": p.get(\"tier\"), \"kind\": ev[\"kind\"]})   # no subject/secret\n        return out","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"90d4ffa1-04e7-4179-844c-4f6ab5196751","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:58:16.052Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"9ca21801-d80d-41a5-ae67-cffcd397c1ec","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

1\n    day = day_iso or datetime.now(timezone.utc).date().isoformat()\n\n    per_agent: Counter = Counter()\n    decisions: Counter = Counter()\n    interrupts_today: Counter = Counter()\n    actions_today: Counter = Counter()\n    last_checkpoint = -1\n    last_consolidation = -1\n    for r in store.iter_records():\n        if r.kind == \"warden_checkpoint\":\n            last_checkpoint = r.seq\n        if r.kind in (\"entity\", \"contradiction\") and r.source == \"agent\":\n            last_consolidation = max(last_consolidation, r.seq)\n        if r.source == \"agent\" and (r.ts or \"\").startswith(day):\n            # count only actions actually TAKEN (auto/queued), mirroring the enforced BudgetLedger —\n            # denials must not inflate the usage panel (red-pen RP-2 honesty).\n            if r.payload.get(\"decision\") in (\"auto\", \"queued\"):\n                actions_today[r.actor] += 1\n                if r.kind == \"event\":\n                    interrupts_today[r.actor] += 1\n        if r.source == \"agent\" and r.seq > head - lookback:\n            per_agent[r.actor] += 1\n            decisions[str(r.payload.get(\"decision\"))] += 1\n\n    pend = pending(store, owner_pubkey())\n    return {\n        \"head_seq\": head,\n        \"kill_switch\": \"ENGAGED\" if KillSwitch(store).is_engaged() else \"released\",\n        \"recent_by_agent\": dict(per_agent.most_common()),\n        \"recent_decisions\": dict(decisions),\n        \"pending_approvals\": [{\"seq\": r.seq, \"tier\": r.payload.get(\"tier\"), \"kind\": r.kind,\n                               \"agent\": r.actor, \"subject\": r.payload.get(\"subject\")} for r in pend],\n        \"budget_today\": {a: {\"actions\": actions_today[a], \"interrupts\": interrupts_today[a]}\n                         for a in sorted(actions_today)},\n        \"ingest_lag\": {\"head_seq\": head, \"last_checkpoint_seq\": last_checkpoint,\n                       \"records_since_checkpoint\": (head - {"parentUuid":"00264e16-e974-4407-88b8-eb94e5fb48e3","isSidechain":true,"agentId":"af4fd46b5647ca30c","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdASQ3SMyrL71suQkLs26","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01JsZuhaDJqRUtvrbrbdNJ5k","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/kali/sigil/sigil/bridge/webapp/app.js","content":"\"use strict\";\n/* SIGIL Companion (Phase 9 W1-C) — the owner's phone PWA for the WireGuard bridge.\n *\n * It holds the phone's OWN Ed25519 device key (WebCrypto, NON-EXTRACTABLE, in IndexedDB) and signs\n * EVERY request locally; the desktop bridge (sigil/bridge/server.py) only VERIFIES. There is no wire\n * bearer secret — authentication IS the signature over the canonical envelope core, checked against\n * the owner-minted authorized-device set (sigil/mesh :: authorized_devices).\n *\n * CRYPTO REQUIREMENTS — WebCrypto Ed25519 is REQUIRED (no vendored/downloaded fallback: the sandbox\n * is offline and we will NOT silently drop to weak crypto). Minimum browsers with Ed25519 in\n * crypto.subtle:  Chrome/Edge 137+ · Safari 17+ · Firefox 129+ · Node 22 (for the parity test).\n * If crypto.subtle lacks Ed25519 the app says so honestly and refuses to operate.\n *\n * ENCODING PARITY with sigil (sigil/reuse/crypto.py):\n *   - device PUBLIC key (raw 32 bytes, exportKey(\"raw\")) and SIGNATURES (raw 64 bytes) are STANDARD\n *     base64 WITH padding (b64std) — because verify_one() -> _b64decode_exact() does\n *     base64.b64decode(value, validate=True), which only accepts the standard alphabet (+ / =).\n *   - the WHOLE envelope JSON that rides in X-SIGIL-Envelope / ?env= is base64URL (b64url), because\n *     the server decodes it with base64.urlsafe_b64decode (padding re-added server-side).\n *   - canonical signing bytes come from SigilCanonical.canonicalJson (see canonical.js — the parity\n *     contract). ts is floored to INTEGER seconds and nonces/seqs are integers so the JS and Python\n *     canonical bytes are byte-identical (floats are never signed).\n *   - the human fingerprint = grouped SHA-256(pubkey-base64-STRING) first 8 bytes as xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-\n *     xxxx, matching sigil/cli.py :: _device_fingerprint (which hashes pubkey.encode(), i.e. the\n *     base64 STRING, NOT the raw key bytes).\n *\n * CSP: default-src 'self'. No inline scripts, no inline event handlers, no external origins. All\n * behaviour is wired by ONE delegated click listener + a few input handlers.\n */\n\n/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- tiny DOM helpers */\nvar $ = function (s) { return document.querySelector(s); };\nvar esc = function (s) {\n  return String(s == null ? \"\" : s).replace(/[&<>]/g, function (c) {\n    return { \"&\": \"&amp;\", \"<\": \"&lt;\", \">\": \"&gt;\" }[c];\n  });\n};\nvar enc = new TextEncoder();\nfunction banner(kind, html) {\n  var b = $(\"#banner\");\n  b.className = \"banner \" + kind;\n  b.innerHTML = html;\n}\nfunction clearBanner() { $(\"#banner\").className = \"banner info hidden\"; }\n\n/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- base64 */\nfunction bytesToB64std(bytes) {                       // standard base64, WITH padding (pubkey / sig)\n  var s = \"\";\n  for (var i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) { s += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]); }\n  return btoa(s);\n}\nfunction strToB64url(str) {                           // base64URL, no padding (the envelope wrapper)\n  return bytesToB64std(enc.encode(str)).replace(/\\+/g, \"-\").replace(/\\//g, \"_\").replace(/=+$/g, \"\");\n}\nfunction toHex(buf) {\n  var v = new Uint8Array(buf), out = \"\";\n  for (var i = 0; i < v.length; i++) { out += v[i].toString(16).padStart(2, \"0\"); }\n  return out;\n}\nasync function sha256Hex(bytes) {                     // == sigil.reuse.sha256_hex\n  return toHex(await crypto.subtle.digest(\"SHA-256\", bytes));\n}\n\n/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- IndexedDB */\n/* One DB, two stores: \"kv\" (device key material + the monotonic nonce) and \"outbox\" (POSTs queued\n * while offline, flushed on reconnect). CryptoKey objects are structured-cloneable, so the\n * NON-EXTRACTABLE private key persists here without ever exposing its bytes. */\nvar DB = null;\nfunction openDB() {\n  return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {\n    var req = indexedDB.open(\"sigil-companion\", 1);\n    req.onupgradeneeded = function () {\n      var db = req.result;\n      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(\"kv\")) { db.createObjectStore(\"kv\", { keyPath: \"k\" }); }\n      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(\"outbox\")) { db.createObjectStore(\"outbox\", { keyPath: \"id\", autoIncrement: true }); }\n    };\n    req.onsuccess = function () { resolve(req.result); };\n    req.onerror = function () { reject(req.error); };\n  });\n}\nfunction tx(store, mode) { return DB.transaction(store, mode).objectStore(store); }\nfunction idbGet(store, key) {\n  return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {\n    var r = tx(store, \"readonly\").get(key);\n    r.onsuccess = function () { resolve(r.result); };\n    r.onerror = function () { reject(r.error); };\n  });\n}\nfunction idbPut(store, val) {\n  return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {\n    var r = tx(store, \"readwrite\").put(val);\n    r.onsuccess = function () { resolve(r.result); };\n    r.onerror = function () { reject(r.error); };\n  });\n}\nfunction idbDel(store, key) {\n  return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {\n    var r = tx(store, \"readwrite\").delete(key);\n    r.onsuccess = function () { resolve(); };\n    r.onerror = function () { reject(r.error); };\n  });\n}\nfunction idbAll(store) {\n  return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {\n    var r = tx(store, \"readonly\").getAll();\n    r.onsuccess = function () { resolve(r.result || []); };\n    r.onerror = function () { reject(r.error); };\n  });\n}\n\n/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------ device key + identity */\nvar DEVICE = null;   // { privateKey: CryptoKey (non-extractable), pubB64: string, deviceId: string, fingerprint: string }\n\nasync function ed25519Available() {\n  if (!(window.crypto && crypto.subtle && crypto.subtle.generateKey)) { return false; }\n  try {\n    var k = await crypto.subtle.generateKey({ name: \"Ed25519\" }, false, [\"sign\", \"verify\"]);\n    return !!(k && k.privateKey && k.publicKey);\n  } catch (e) { return false; }\n}\n\nfunction randomDeviceId() {\n  var b = new Uint8Array(4);\n  crypto.getRandomValues(b);\n  return \"phone-\" + toHex(b.buffer);\n}\n\nasync function loadOrCreateDevice() {\n  var rec = await idbGet(\"kv\", \"device\");\n  if (rec && rec.privateKey && rec.pubB64) {\n    DEVICE = { privateKey: rec.privateKey, pubB64: rec.pubB64, deviceId: rec.deviceId, fingerprint: rec.fingerprint };\n    return DEVICE;\n  }\n  // First run on this device: mint a fresh NON-EXTRACTABLE key. [\"sign\",\"verify\"] so the (always-\n  // extractable) public key carries a valid usage; the private key stays extractable=false. We only\n  // ever exportKey(\"raw\") the PUBLIC key.\n  var pair = await crypto.subtle.generateKey({ name: \"Ed25519\" }, false, [\"sign\", \"verify\"]);\n  var raw = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.exportKey(\"raw\", pair.publicKey));  // 32 bytes\n  var pubB64 = bytesToB64std(raw);\n  var short = (await sha256Hex(enc.encode(pubB64))).slice(0, 16);\n  var fingerprint = [short.slice(0, 4), short.slice(4, 8), short.slice(8, 12), short.slice(12, 16)].join(\"-\");\n  var deviceId = randomDeviceId();\n  DEVICE = { privateKey: pair.privateKey, pubB64: pubB64, deviceId: deviceId, fingerprint: fingerprint };\n  await idbPut(\"kv\", { k: \"device\", privateKey: pair.privateKey, pubB64: pubB64, deviceId: deviceId, fingerprint: fingerprint });\n  await idbPut(\"kv\", { k: \"nonce\", v: 0 });\n  return DEVICE;\n}\n\nasync function nextNonce() {                          // monotonic, per-device, persisted (replay gate)\n  var rec = await idbGet(\"kv\", \"nonce\");\n  var n = (rec && typeof rec.v === \"number\" ? rec.v : 0) + 1;\n  await idbPut(\"kv\", { k: \"nonce\", v: n });\n  return n;\n}\n\nasync function signBytes(msgBytes) {                  // -> standard-base64 signature\n  var sig = await crypto.subtle.sign(\"Ed25519\", DEVICE.privateKey, msgBytes);\n  return bytesToB64std(new Uint8Array(sig));\n}\n\n/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------- envelope builder */\n/* core = {v,device,action,args,nonce,ts}; sign canonicalJson(core); wrapper = base64url(JSON). */\nasync function buildEnvelope(action, args, nonce) {\n  var core = {\n    v: 1,\n    device: DEVICE.pubB64,\n    action: action,\n    args: args || {},\n    nonce: nonce,\n    ts: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)   // INTEGER seconds — byte-parity with Python; server window is +/-120s\n  };\n  var sig = await signBytes(enc.encode(SigilCanonical.canonicalJson(core)));\n  var wrapper = {};\n  for (var kk in core) { if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(core, kk)) { wrapper[kk] = core[kk]; } }\n  wrapper.sig = sig;\n  return strToB64url(JSON.stringify(wrapper));\n}\n\n/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- networking */\nfunction on401(status) {                              // a read/action was refused as unauthenticated\n  if (status === 401 || status === 403) {\n    banner(\"warn\", \"This device is not authorized yet (or its signature was refused). Pair it on the PC \"\n      + \"(see the Pairing panel), then it will connect.\");\n  }\n}\n\nasync function authedGet(path, action, extraQuery) {  // a signed READ (envelope in the header)\n  var env = await buildEnvelope(action, {}, await nextNonce());\n  var url = path + (extraQuery ? (\"?\" + extraQuery) : \"\");\n  var r = await fetch(url, { headers: { \"X-SIGIL-Envelope\": env }, cache: \"no-store\" });\n  if (!r.ok) { on401(r.status); throw new Error(\"GET \" + path + \" -> \" + r.status); }\n  clearBanner();\n  return r.json();\n}\n\nasync function effectfulPost(path, action, args) {    // panic / relay — signed, replay-gated\n  var env = await buildEnvelope(action, args || {}, await nextNonce());\n  var req = { path: path, headers: { \"X-SIGIL-Envelope\": env }, body: \"\" };\n  return deliver(req);\n}\n\nasync function postApproval(seq, decision) {          // device-signed governor.approval -> /api/action\n  var approver = \"device\";\n  var msgBytes = enc.encode(SigilCanonical.canonicalJson({ approver: approver, decision: decision, target: seq }));\n  var sig = await signBytes(msgBytes);\n  var payload = {\n    signal: \"governor.approval\", approval: decision, target_seq: seq,\n    approver: approver, reason: \"\", pubkey: DEVICE.pubB64, sig: sig,\n    msg_digest: await sha256Hex(msgBytes), device: true\n  };\n  var req = { path: \"/api/action\", headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) };\n  return deliver(req);\n}\n\n/* deliver: try now; if the network is unreachable, QUEUE it (already signed) and flush on reconnect.\n * If the server RESPONDS (any HTTP status) the item is considered delivered — the server adjudicated. */\nasync function deliver(req) {\n  try {\n    var r = await fetch(req.path, {\n      method: \"POST\", headers: req.headers, body: req.body, cache: \"no-store\"\n    });\n    var j = await r.json().catch(function () { return {}; });\n    return { ok: r.ok, status: r.status, body: j };\n  } catch (netErr) {\n    await idbPut(\"outbox\", { req: req, at: Date.now() });\n    return { ok: false, queued: true, status: 0, body: { error: \"offline — signed and queued; will flush on reconnect\" } };\n  }\n}\n\nasync function flushOutbox() {\n  if (!DB) { return; }\n  var items = await idbAll(\"outbox\");\n  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {\n    var it = items[i];\n    try {\n      await fetch(it.req.path, { method: \"POST\", headers: it.req.headers, body: it.req.body, cache: \"no-store\" });\n      await idbDel(\"outbox\", it.id);                 // server responded (any status) -> stop retrying\n    } catch (e) {\n      /* still offline — keep it queued */\n    }\n  }\n  renderOutbox();\n}\n\n/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- renderers */\nasync function renderPairing() {\n  var host = $(\"#pair-body\");\n  host.innerHTML =\n    '<div class=\"mono\">device id</div><code class=\"sel\">' + esc(DEVICE.deviceId) + '</code>'\n    + '<div class=\"mono mt\">device public key (base64)</div><code class=\"sel\" id=\"pubkey\">' + esc(DEVICE.pubB64) + '</code>'\n    + '<div class=\"mono mt\">fingerprint (eyeball-match this on the PC)</div><div class=\"fp\">' + esc(DEVICE.fingerprint) + '</div>'\n    + '<div class=\"acts mt\"><button data-act=\"copy-pub\">Copy public key</button>'\n    + '<button data-act=\"copy-cmd\">Copy authorize command</button></div>'\n    + '<div class=\"instr\">On the PC, run:<br><code id=\"authcmd\">sigil mesh authorize ' + esc(DEVICE.deviceId) + ' ' + esc(DEVICE.pubB64)\n    + '</code><br>Confirm the printed fingerprint equals <b>' + esc(DEVICE.fingerprint) + '</b> before you accept it.</div>';\n}\n\nasync function refreshPending() {\n  var q = $(\"#queue\");\n  var data;\n  try { data = await authedGet(\"/api/pending\", \"read:pending\"); It holds the phone's OWN\nEd25519 device key and signs LOCALLY; the desktop bridge only verifies.\n\nThese tests assert three things the slice must hold:\n  1. all webapp files exist and are non-empty;\n  2. CSP-safety — no external origins, no inline event handlers, no inline <script> bodies (the app\n     is served under a strict `default-src 'self'` CSP that would break any of those);\n  3. the #1 correctness item — CANONICALIZATION PARITY: the JS `canonicalJson` (canonical.js) must\n     reproduce, BYTE-FOR-BYTE, the exact signed bytes the Python bridge verifies\n     (sigil.bridge.envelope.envelope_message / sigil.reuse.canonical_json). This is run under Node so\n     it is falsifiable, not asserted by inspection.\n\nRun: ~/.sigil/venv/bin/python tests/test_bridge_webapp.py\n\"\"\"\nimport json\nimport re\nimport shutil\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom sigil.bridge import build_core, envelope_message\nfrom sigil.reuse import canonical_json\n\nfrom sigil.bridge import envelope as _E\nWEBAPP = Path(_E.__file__).parent / \"webapp\"\n\nFILES = [\"index.html\", \"app.js\", \"style.css\", \"manifest.json\", \"service-worker.js\", \"canonical.js\"]\n\n\ndef _read(name):\n    return (WEBAPP / name).read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n\n# ---- 1. every webapp file exists and is non-empty -------------------------------------------------\ndef test_all_webapp_files_exist_and_nonempty():\n    for name in FILES:\n        p = WEBAPP / name\n        assert p.is_file(), f\"missing webapp file: {name}\"\n        assert p.stat().st_size > 0, f\"empty webapp file: {name}\"\n\n\n# ---- 2a. no external origins in the JS/HTML (CSP default-src 'self') ------------------------------\ndef test_no_external_origins():\n    for name in (\"app.js\", \"index.html\"):\n        text = _read(name)\n        assert \"http://\" not in text, f\"{name} must not reference an http:// external origin\"\n        assert \"https://\" not in text, f\"{name} must not reference an https:// external origin\"\n\n\n# ---- 2b. no inline event handlers (event-delegation discipline only) -----------------------------\ndef test_no_inline_event_handlers():\n    for name in (\"app.js\", \"index.html\"):\n        text = _read(name)\n        assert \"onclick=\" not in text, f\"{name} must not use an inline onclick= handler\"\n        assert \"onload=\" not in text, f\"{name} must not use an inline onload= handler\"\n    # index.html: no HTML tag may carry ANY inline on*= handler attribute\n    html = _read(\"index.html\")\n    inline_attr = re.compile(r\"<[a-zA-Z][^>]*\\son[a-z]+\\s*=\", re.DOTALL)\n    assert not inline_attr.search(html), \"index.html has an inline on*= handler attribute (CSP-unsafe)\"\n\n\n# ---- 2c. index.html has only <script src=...> — no inline script body -----------------------------\ndef test_index_scripts_are_external_only():\n    html = _read(\"index.html\")\n    scripts = re.findall(r\"<script\\b([^>]*)>(.*?)</script>\", html, re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)\n    assert scripts, \"index.html should load the app via <script src=...>\"\n    for attrs, body in scripts:\n        assert \"src=\" in attrs, f\"<script{attrs}> has no src= (inline script is CSP-unsafe)\"\n        assert body.strip() == \"\", f\"<script{attrs}> has an inline body (CSP-unsafe): {body!r}\"\n\n\n# ---- 2d. the JS wires behaviour via a delegated listener + holds no vendored crypto ---------------\ndef test_app_uses_event_delegation_and_webcrypto_only():\n    app = _read(\"app.js\")\n    assert 'addEventListener(\"click\"' in app, \"app.js must wire clicks via event delegation\"\n    assert \"crypto.subtle\" in app and \"Ed25519\" in app, \"app.js must use WebCrypto Ed25519\"\n    # honest failure path if the browser cannot hold a device key (no silent weak-crypto fallback)\n    assert \"can't hold a device key\" in app or \"cannot hold a device key\" in app, \\\n        \"app.js must fail honestly when crypto.subtle lacks Ed25519\"\n\n\n# ---- 3. CANONICALIZATION PARITY (the signed-bytes contract), verified under Node ------------------\n_NODE_SCRIPT = (\n    \"const {canonicalJson}=require(process.env.CANON);\"\n    \"const core=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]);\"\n    \"process.stdout.write(Buffer.from(canonicalJson(core),'utf8'));\"\n)\n\n\ndef _node_canonical(core: dict) -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"Run the SHIPPED JS canonicalJson (canonical.js) under Node over `core`; return its UTF-8 bytes.\"\"\"\n    out = subprocess.run(\n        [\"node\", \"-e\", _NODE_SCRIPT, json.dumps(core)],\n        env={\"CANON\": str((WEBAPP / \"canonical.js\").resolve()), \"PATH\": __import__(\"os\").environ.get(\"PATH\", \"\")},\n        capture_output=True, timeout=30,\n    )\n    assert out.returncode == 0, f\"node canonicalJson failed: {out.stderr.decode(errors='replace')}\"\n    return out.stdout\n\n\ndef test_canonicaljson_parity_via_node():\n    if not shutil.which(\"node\"):\n        print(\"  SKIP  node not present — canonicalization parity NOT verified (install Node 22 to falsify)\")\n        return\n\n    # (a) the DOCUMENTED fixed envelope vector — byte-identical to sigil.bridge.envelope.envelope_message\n    core = build_core(\"DEVKEYB64\", \"read:snapshot\", {}, 1, 1700000000)\n    expected = b'{\"action\":\"read:snapshot\",\"args\":{},\"device\":\"DEVKEYB64\",\"nonce\":1,\"ts\":1700000000,\"v\":1}'\n    assert envelope_message(core) == expected, \"the Python parity contract byte string drifted\"\n    js = _node_canonical(core)\n    assert js == expected, f\"JS canonicalJson drifted from the pinned vector:\\n  py={expected!r}\\n  js={js!r}\"\n    assert js == envelope_message(core), \"JS canonicalJson != Python envelope_message (signatures would be rejected)\"\n\n    # (b) the approval message the phone signs for /api/action — canonical_json({approver,decision,target})\n    approval = {\"approver\": \"device\", \"decision\": \"approved\", \"target\": 5}\n    assert _node_canonical(approval) == canonical_json(approval), \"approval-message canonicalization drifted\"\n\n    # (c) nested / unicode / integer edges — key sort recurses, non-ASCII stays raw, ints have no .0\n    for obj in (\n        {\"b\": 2, \"a\": {\"z\": [3, 2, 1], \"y\": \"x\"}, \"n\": None, \"t\": True, \"f\": False},\n        {\"device\": \"abc/def+ghi==\", \"note\": \"café — naïve ✓\", \"nonce\": 42},\n        {\"args\": {\"text\": \"halt now\"}, \"action\": \"relay\", \"v\": 1, \"nonce\": 7, \"ts\": 1700000123, \"device\": \"K\"},\n    ):\n        assert _node_canonical(obj) == canonical_json(obj), f\"canonicalization parity failed for {obj!r}\"\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    fns = [v for k, v in sorted(globals().items()) if k.startswith(\"test_\")]\n    passed = 0\n    for fn in fns:\n        try:\n            fn(); print(f\"  PASS  {fn.__name__}\"); passed += 1\n        except AssertionError as e:\n            print(f\"  FAIL  {fn.__name__}: {e}\")\n        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001\n            import traceback\n            print(f\"  ERROR {fn.__name__}: {e}\")\n            traceback.print_exc()\n    print(f\"{passed}/{len(fns)} Phase-9 W1-C (Companion PWA) guarantees hold\")\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1371,"cache_read_input_tokens":110466,"output_tokens":5586,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":1371},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":5586,"cache_read_input_tokens":110466,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1371,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":1371,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011CdASec8X1PnbFy9WDtSG6","attributionAgent":"general-purpose","type":"assistant","uuid":"a446f961-47f2-41ca-8f63-0cf1aa47709a","timestamp":"2026-07-19T00:09:24.331Z","effort":"xhigh","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}
